title: Distributionally Robust Risk Evaluation with Low-Rank Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2611.17447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study distributionally robust risk under perturbations restricted to low-rank matrices whose row and column spaces are shared across observations, focusing on how much worst-case risk this restriction sacrifices and how to compute the restricted worst case. Under moment or Wasserstein budgets, we derive quantitative bounds on the gap between the unrestricted and low-rank worst-case risks, characterize when the gap vanishes, and identify the smallest lossless row and column dimensions. To generate worst-case perturbations, we apply projected gradient ascent to a curvature-corrected concave problem and derive computable risk certificates. We establish global sublinear convergence for the corrected objective and linear convergence to a worst-case distribution when the budget constraint is sufficiently active.

translated_title: 基于低秩扰动的分布鲁棒风险评估
translated_abstract: 我们研究分布在受限于低秩矩阵扰动下的鲁棒风险，其中这些低秩矩阵的行空间和列空间在各观测之间共享，重点关注这种限制会牺牲多少最坏情况风险，以及如何计算受限后的最坏情况。在矩约束或Wasserstein预算下，我们推导了无限制最坏情况风险与低秩最坏情况风险之间差距的定量界限，刻画了差距消失的条件，并确定了最小的无损行和列维度。为了生成最坏情况扰动，我们对曲率校正后的凹问题应用投影梯度上升方法，并推导出可计算的风险证书。我们为校正后的目标函数建立了全局次线性收敛性，并在预算约束充分激活时证明了向最坏情况分布的线性收敛性。
tldr: 该论文量化了将分布鲁棒扰动限制为行/列空间共享的低秩矩阵时最坏情况风险的损失，提出了基于曲率校正的投影梯度上升算法来计算最坏情况扰动，并给出了收敛性保证与可计算的风险证书。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the worst-case risk sacrifice caused by restricting distributionally robust perturbations to low-rank matrices with shared row and column spaces, and develops a curvature-corrected projected gradient ascent algorithm with global sublinear convergence, linear convergence guarantees, and computable risk certificates.
